dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING, LINKAGE SECTION with MCP/SPA/LINKAGE areas typical of ORCA middleware.
evidence: PROCEDURE DIVISION USING MCPAREA SPAAREA LINKAREA SCRAREA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - hospital admission/discharge billing confirmation screen (nyuuin seikyu kakunin gaamen)
purpose.summary: This program implements a hospital admission billing confirmation screen (ORCGI04) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles patient admission/discharge registration, insurance combination management, periodic billing history, and payment detail processing. It is an online screen program driven by MCP events (LINK, PUTG/CLICKED, and other input events).

notable_features: 70 COPY statements with REPLACING for modular record layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with MCP/SPA/LINK/SCR areas (ORCA middleware pattern)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen control
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (uses proprietary MCP DB access layer)
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP/latin-1 (garbled in ASCII view)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are Japanese EUC-JP encoded, appearing garbled. This is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system (JMA ORCA). The program is an online screen handler using the ORCA MCP middleware framework rather than CICS, but is functionally equivalent to an online-cics program type. Source is fixed-format COBOL with max line length 74.
